data.name: Injah
data.gender_notes: Injah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-h' which means 'to be gracious, to favor, to be kind, to show mercy, and to grant'. Injah is a name that signifies the bestowal of divine blessings and favors upon an individual. The name Injah carries the meaning “Grace, Favor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Injah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the divine grace and favor bestowed upon an individual.
data.etymology: Injah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Injah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
